```lean
intro s f hf
apply Set.ext
intro x
split
· intro h1
  have h2 := hf x
  apply (Set.mem_image_iff' _ _).1 h1
  intro y
  rcases h1 with ⟨y, h3, h4⟩
  rw [h4, h2]
  exact h3
· intro h2
  have h3 := hf x
  apply (Set.mem_image_iff' _ _).1 h2
  intro y
  rcases h2 with ⟨y, h4, h5⟩
  rw [h5, h3]
  exact h4
```
